negativeControls.kind: Copied-source dome and grass geometry faults
negativeControls.qualification: Initial controller looked for a width-message literal that was not the actual first failure. The preserved reporter correctly has two intended failures and three passes. Qualification reads that exact reporter and checks the actual dome-aspect and grass projected-area failure, without rerunning or altering tests.

plant.reason: These stale expectations predate the accepted pass28 spatial water pulse. Frond/bladder regexes require motion.x for clPlantX and omit accepted Z+1.7 and pulse weight, causing module-load failures before grass checks. Geometry expects the former per-plant accumulated motion.x clock; the actual0.42 value is1200*.00035. The accepted independent ripple rate is now in motion.y. Two cache-key and one later bladder resume assertions would be stale after import is repaired. Pass30 changes only squid fins/roughness; pass32 exact reversals contain no plant shader/clock/loop change.
plant.preserved: Every geometry attribute/golden/prefix/closed-shell/ray/anchor/normal/triangle/footprint assertion, numerical tolerance, phase sweep, pause/reduced-motion snapshot, once-only disposal and RNG assertion remains unchanged. Current wave phases and amplitudes are pinned exactly; actual GLSL pulse and analytic derivative are executed. The y clock retains the original per-kind frequency assertions alongside the new shared x clock.

nativeBudget.reason: Three browser cases reached their total180second limit at later inspection/help stages in the constrained host. This is not evidence that controls were absent or animation was stranded. Preserve every assertion, frame count, input and retry limit; enlarge only these three cases budget.

priorAttempts.reason: Pre-pass28 shader/phase/cache expectations in three older plant tests. Current motion source is exactly unchanged; documented test-only migrations decode and verify accepted live motion, retaining all tolerances and goldens.

Three long cases reached total180second limit late in inspection/help. Increased only their budgets to480seconds, preserving every frame, assertion and zero retries; all three rerun on unchanged production.
Two intended faults were detected and three cases passed. Initial controller searched for the wrong first grass failure literal; saved reporter qualified independently without a rerun.

First negative controller supplied an absolute path as a browser tool URL and received404 before model rendering. It was rejected. Corrected source substitution uses the canonical asset URL; native-fault-qualified.json catches the actual Observe text regression.

limits: Focused55-case final validation, not whole-repository coverage
Copied-source failures are deliberate and separate from positive coverage
Static grass has more opaque coverage; unchanged buffers do not prove unchanged raster cost
Biological motion is an illustrative animation, not a fluid simulation
Performance of the constrained test host does not establish target-device frame rate
